summary.en: Bayern striker Harry Kane won the Ballon d'Or in London, the first Bundesliga player to win it since 1996.
summary.sw: Mshambuliaji wa Bayern Harry Kane ameshinda Ballon d'Or mjini London, mchezaji wa kwanza wa Bundesliga kushinda tuzo hiyo tangu 1996.

title.sw: Teksi za Berlin kuacha kuchukua abiria BER

summary.en: From 1 January 2027 Berlin taxis may no longer pick up passengers at BER airport; booking by phone or app stays possible.
summary.sw: Kuanzia 1 Januari 2027 teksi za Berlin haziruhusiwi kuchukua abiria uwanja wa ndege wa BER; kuagiza kwa simu au programu bado kunawezekana.

summary.en: The fifth meeting of Parliament starts today in Dodoma and runs until 6 November, with 160 questions planned.
summary.sw: Mkutano wa tano wa Bunge unaanza leo Dodoma hadi tarehe 6 Novemba, na maswali 160 yamepangwa.

summary.en: A Dar es Salaam fertility centre offers a genetic test for embryos and says it has done over 800 screenings.
summary.sw: Kituo cha uzazi Dar es Salaam kinatoa kipimo cha vinasaba vya viinitete na kinasema kimefanya vipimo zaidi ya 800.

title.en: Medikea opens a clinic in Arusha

summary.en: Healthcare company Medikea raised 1.2 million dollars and opened new clinics in Arusha and Morogoro.
summary.sw: Kampuni ya afya Medikea imepata dola milioni 1.2 na kufungua kliniki mpya Arusha na Morogoro.

Maneno matano: der Fußball = mpira wa miguu; das Taxi = teksi; der Flughafen = uwanja wa ndege; spielen = kucheza; das Jahr = mwaka. Emin: Bunge linakutana leo. = Parliament meets today. Marudio: Der Eintritt ist frei. = Kiingilio ni bure. Wie spät ist es? = Ni saa ngapi? Mazoezi haya hayathibitishi utayari wa mtihani.
